name: Sharon Adabat
original_name: シャロン・アダバット
source:
"I can see through all lies, so I can't trust anyone."
The Prime Minister of Kingdom.
He's busy running the country in the absence of the royal family.
Because he has been around politicians since he was young he can tell when people are lying.
He became prime minister quite young after taking over from his dead father.
His administration is just, but it is also strict, so the people don't adore him very much.
